scene_description: A compact, well-lit stone brick room (7x7 interior, 4 blocks tall) with glowstone ceiling lights. A single spruce trapdoor is placed on the east interior wall at y+1 height, in the open position facing west. The grey stone brick walls provide excellent visual contrast with the brown wooden trapdoor, making it easy to locate. The room is fully enclosed so the player stays focused on finding and mining the trapdoor.
task_text: Find and mine the spruce trapdoor on the wall of this stone brick room.
design_notes: The room is 9x9 outer (stone bricks), 7x7 inner (air). Walls go from y+0 to y+3 (4 blocks tall), ceiling at y+4. The spruce trapdoor is at relative position (~3, ~1, ~0) on the east wall, open and facing west so it appears as a flat square on the wall. Five glowstone blocks in the ceiling provide ample lighting. The trapdoor breaks instantly by hand (no tool needed) and drops itself as an inventory item. The trapdoor's brown wood texture contrasts sharply with the grey stone bricks, confirmed via sandbox preview.
